turns.speaker: yours
turns.text: Hi, I'm calling on behalf of a team of eight. Could we get a table tonight at seven?

turns.speaker: restaurant
turns.text: Good evening! At seven we only have the terrace, or I can seat you indoors at half past eight.

turns.speaker: yours
turns.text: For a group of eight, indoors at half past eight sounds better. Do you have a vegetarian option?

turns.speaker: restaurant
turns.text: Absolutely, our vegetarian menu is three courses, about thirty-eight euros per person.

turns.speaker: yours
turns.text: Perfect, that fits our budget. Please book eight people indoors at eight thirty.

turns.speaker: restaurant
turns.text: Done! Eight people, half past eight, indoors, with the vegetarian menu ready. See you tonight.
